entities.summary: Karl Joachim Aloys Franz von Paula zu Fürstenberg-Stühlingen was a German nobleman and member of the House of Fürstenberg. He was born and died in Donaueschingen and from 1796 to 1804 was the eighth reigning Prince of Fürstenberg.
